title: Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Online Form Live: 6565 Posts Apply Now #RRBTechnician2026 #RRBCEN022026 #ALPTechnicianRRB #RailwayRecruitment2026 #SarkariNaukri
intro: RRB Railway has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the for the Post of Technician Gr-I & Grade-III (CEN.No.02/2026) Recruitment 2026 for 6565 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to RRB Technician Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 30, 2026 & Last Date for Application is July 29, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Exam City : 10 Days Before Exam Date
Exam Admit Card: 04 Days Before Exam Date
Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode.
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Technician Gr-I (Signal):- BE / B.Tech / Engineering Diploma / B.SC Engineering Degree.
Technician Gr-III Open Line & Technician Gr-III Workshop & Pus :- Class 10th with ITI Certficate in Related Trade Or Pass Class 10th with PCM Subject.
For Complete Trade Wise Qualification (CEN-02/2025):  Click Here
For Complete Trade Wise Qualification (CEN-02/2026):  Notify Later
Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
Pay Scale – Technician Gr-III:-Rs.19,900-63,200 (Level-2) ||  Technician Gr-I (Signal):  Rs.29,200-92,300 (Level-5)
Mode of  Selection on the based CBT Exam, DV & Medical Exam.
To Be Notified: CBT Exam Date
Age Relaxation: As per Railway Rules.
10th Pass + ITI in relevant trade OR 10th + Diploma in Engineering
Selection Process: CBT-1 + CBT-2 + Document Verification + Medical Test
Central Government Railway Job with Good Salary
Excellent Career Growth in Indian Railways
